reason: The cabinet approval of a strategic stake sale to Fairfax for Rs 52,878 crore acts as a major catalyst for valuation re-rating and structural transformation.
why_now: The news of the cabinet approval surfaced today, October 14, 2026, with the company currently awaiting formal response to exchange queries.
source_headlines: IDBI Bank Limited: The Exchange has sought clarification from IDBI Bank Limited with respect to recent news item captioned Cabinet Approves IDBI Bank Stake Sale To Fairfax For Rs 52,878 Crore; FM Calls It Strategic Restructuring. The response from the Company is awaited.
